title: The totals row stays visible at the bottom while the user scrolls the rows
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The page shows more rows than fit on the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Scroll the rows up and down.
2. Watch the totals row.
custom_expected: 1. The totals row stays visible at the bottom while the rows scroll.
